about: What the landscape picker says about each base landscape (intro screen, web and native). Ids stay as saved; mountains is shown as Steppe. `trait` is the one real difference today and must match the weights in sky-events.json `biomes`: weather odds and aurora chance only. Landscape never locks any gameplay.
heading: Choose where to build
lede: Your launch complex and everything you add will stand here.
note: A landscape changes the look and the sky only. You can move your base once later.
